discount.description: 15% discount applies to base charges only

overage.text: Overage rate: $0.08 per unit above monthly limit of 5,000 units. Overage charges invoiced as a separate line item on the monthly bill.

base_limit.text: Base usage limit: 5,000 units per month. Units measured as individual API transactions.

discount_scope.text: Discounts apply to base subscription fees only. Overage, add-on, and professional services charges are excluded from discount programs.
